title: Eopatch/Glucomen Day pump connection problem phone pixel 7a
body:
not relevant anymore because of ending delivery of  Eopatchpump soon

Bluetooth communication problem when trying to connect Glucomen day pump with pixel 7a.
New pod isn't shown when trying to connect. Also working pod on another phone could not be transferred to pixel 7a . Reporting "communication problem". Emptied bluetooth cache , didn't help
AAPS 3.2.0.1

not relevant anymore

comments.body:
> Bluetooth communication problem when trying to connect Glucomen day pump with pixel 7a. New pod isn't shown when trying to connect. Also working pod on another phone could not be transferred to pixel 7a . Reporting "communication problem". Emptied bluetooth cache , didn't help AAPS 3.2.0.1
> 
> [AndroidAPS_LOG_1698487464169.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/13195483/AndroidAPS_LOG_1698487464169.log.zip)

The exact same thing just happened to me With the latest version 3.2.0.1, and with two new ones from EoPatch and on two different phones, Pixel 7 and Oneplus Nord 3.

Now reinstalling the dev-m.
I'm able to pair EOP2 with S10e and 3.2.0.1-dev

> I'm able to pair EOP2 with S10e and 3.2.0.1-dev

Thank you very much for your verification @MilosKozak !!

What I did see, when changing to another phone, is that when importing my previous profile/settings (json), data is brought from the pod that I had when I exported the json file. (example: insulin used, insulin remaining, days consumed from the pod)

Is this normal? Could it be bringing data from the old pod and causing problems when pairing the new one?


I don't know if this is necessary but lately I have been exporting my data, when I don't have any pod in place, and so that it doesn't take any data from the pod so that in a future import it doesn't take any data about it.


Thank you very much again for everything and greetings
